npcs.name: Drago
npcs.personal_history: Drago was saved by the townsfolk in Hallowmere and in return he fought many battles to protect the town. His last adventure broke him, leaving him a shadow of himself. He bought Drago's Den, which everyone in town call's Drago's Dive, where he drinks through all of the money he makes selling booze to the latest crop of fools willing to do the people of Hallowmere's bidding

dialogs.title: Welcome to Drago's Den
dialogs.text: Burp! Hi there, fresh meat... Welcome to Drago's Den, a place to come and meet fools like yourself who are looking for trouble in Varnfell.

npcs.name: Rosetta
npcs.personal_history: Rosetta's is the last of a family that used to be the center of social life in Hallowmere. Her family fell to misfortune and these days she takes any work that she can find to care for herself and her brother.

dialogs.title: Introduction
dialogs.text: Hello, are you new to Hallowmere? Be careful with what you do while here in town. Hallowmere has a way of tearing down the most robust of souls and families.

npcs.name: Albert
npcs.personal_history: Albert arrived in Hallowmere as a young child who was too young to pitch into the town's defense. Instead of going off to war, Albert learned the armor trade and now outfits anyone in Halloween with good coin.

npcs.name: Chicken
npcs.personal_history: Don't test me, I used to be a dinasaur!

npcs.name: Leroy
npcs.personal_history: Leroy is a trader who has contacts from all over southern Vernfell

npcs.name: Wanda
npcs.personal_history: Wanda is a collector of rare swords and items of war

npcs.name: Everlyia
npcs.personal_history: Everlyia makes her home on the outskirts of Hallowmere, where she forages for healing herbs in the tradition of her people.

npcs.name: Hrefna
npcs.personal_history: Hrefna is the Voice of the Deep Ones, a race of deep sea dwellers of enormous power that filled the gap when the Old Gods departed Varnfell. The Deep Ones look after the inhabitants of Hallowmere, but at great cost.

npcs.name: Otto
npcs.personal_history: Otto comes from the founding family of Hallowmere. While being a glad hand and popular in town, he turned out not to be suitable for politics and instead opened up Otto's Inn.

npcs.name: Alric Silv
npcs.personal_history: Alric Silv is the "rouge" regent of Hallowsmere. His family has rules Hallowmere since the Great King disappeared with his entourage of adventures. He rules with an iron fist and makes sure that anyone who seeks the protection of Hallowmere earns their place.
